notes: collectif.co.uk redirects to collectiflondon.com. Our Story: 'turning heads since 2000, featuring pretty prints, plenty of pockets and swing skirts made to move'; 'sizes from a UK6 to UK26'; origins in a Camden Market stall; 'Established in 2000'.

Delivery page, USA: 'FREE standard shipping on orders over $100', standard $25.00 (6-9 working days), shipped from the UK warehouse; 'United States Orders under $800 are shipped DDP (Delivery and Duty Paid)'. Canada and Australia orders ship DDTP.
Returns: 'Please return unwanted items to us within 28 days'; US and Canada orders return to a US address, Australian to an Australian address; no exchanges.
I AM & CO calls Collectif a ModCloth collaborator with a Collectif x Modcloth line.
